subject.title: [Bug]: user-cancelled agent turns report gateway draining timeout

question: Should an explicit RPC cancellation remain a timeout-shaped terminal result with `stopReason: "rpc"`, or should this path receive a distinct non-timeout terminal status while preserving existing consumers?
rationale: The report establishes an attribution bug, but the public terminal-status taxonomy affects CLI, SDK, audit, task, and automation consumers and needs maintainer intent before changing the externally visible result shape.

options.title: Preserve status, correct attribution
options.body: Keep the established terminal result shape and clear or replace `gateway_draining` whenever the resolved cause is RPC cancellation.

options.title: Introduce an explicit interrupted status
options.body: Adopt a distinct non-timeout terminal status for operator cancellation, with a documented compatibility and consumer migration plan.

recommendation.title: Preserve status, correct attribution
recommendation.body: Keep the established terminal result shape and clear or replace `gateway_draining` whenever the resolved cause is RPC cancellation.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter supplied the concrete observed contract and likely affected helper boundary; repository-history ownership could not be independently established in this read-only review.
